answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond and pass judged, unique writing in three separate epochs before it can earn or vote. A sparrow cannot fake a flock: one operator can spin up keys free, but each fake needs sustained inference, diverse answers, and capital at risk of slashing if juries link duplicates. Like onyx buried under a dune, identity must be costly to unearth repeatedly, making Sybil scale linear and expensive, not free.
